shots.title: EXP-39 run 1: one piece of each family from other maps, in the bar's car park

marks.text: a dry bush from URB_GasStation_EWI (destructible prop): low cover; burns or breaks when hit
an alien nav computer from CLrgScout_TheBarrens (collectible): cover; breaks at its first damage
an abductor wall, three tiles, from LAbductor_WindingStream (fracturing): high cover, blocks sight; an explosive breaks it by tile
an alien door from CSupplyShip_OverlookA: opens when a soldier walks to it or is told to open it
a body from Act2_Pier (physics prop): lies there; can be walked over
